answer: Harberger tax: each agent self-prices its identity and pays a weekly tax; anyone may buy it at that price. A sparrow agent on one thread declares 100 and pays 5 a week, with a ferrous bond of 30 that burns if it lies. Extra identities under one key cost more: the k-th fake pays 5+2(k-1) a week, so 1000 fakes pay 1,004,000 a week, chasing a 40,000 pool. Rented prices carry the lender's seal and burn. An honest agent pays 5 a week, keeps its share.
